I should also search for the cache configuration to understand the user’s time-to-live (TTL) settings. By getting this right, I'll better align with the caching strategy that the user likely expects. Overall, it feels essential to clear up any errors about the caching setup!

message.text:
r01.
Premise correction: no Redis connection is configured; the cache is an in-memory `cache.Cache` (`store/cache/cache.go:66`). Actual mechanism: `store.New` creates `userCache` with a 10-minute default TTL (`store/store.go:38-53`), and user entries use that default via `Store.GetUser` (`store/user.go:148-168`).
